text_sanskrit: अनन्तविजयं राजा कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः । नकुलः सहदेवश्च सुघोषमणिपुष्पकौ ॥ १-१६ ॥
itrans: anantavijaya.n rAjA kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH . nakulaH sahadevashcha sughoShamaNipuShpakau .. 1-16 ..
translation: The King Yudhishtira, the son of Kunti (blew his conch) Anantavijaya; and Nakula and Sahadeva, (their conches), Sughosha and Manipushpaka.
